title: Tiered fallback validation with atomic snapshot assertions
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build and validate a deterministic active->passive promotion procedure that verifies snapshot immutability and ensures atomic restore assertions before any customer traffic is routed. We will codify a 'tiered fallback' sequence: 1) service quarantine + read-only probes, 2) immutable snapshot import and checksum assertion, 3) staged prefix/KV replay smoke tests, 4) gradual traffic siphon with circuit-breaker guards and SLO regression checks. Outcome: a repeatable automation harness and checklist that reduces recovery uncertainty and provides observable gates (metrics, checksums, 99p latency, error budget burn).
acceptance_criteria: Automation harness (dr-assert) can restore a region from snapshot and produce a deterministic checksum report
Staged traffic siphon script can shift 0->100% traffic in <=30 minutes with configurable steps and automatic rollback on SLO regression
Circuit-breaker integration triggers at defined error/latency thresholds and reverses promotion within defined SLAs
Post-restore data integrity tests (k-v sequence compare) show no unexplained deltas for 99.9% of keys in validation set

comments: 2026-03-02 - Kickoff: scoped requirements with PM and SRE. Decided to gate traffic with SLO regression + checksum agreement rather than manual signoff.
2026-03-05 - PR opened: dr-assert skeleton for snapshot import and checksum compare. Initial CI job created but marked flaky on large snapshots.
2026-03-10 - Smoke run in staging: snapshot import completed, checksum matched, but KV replay latency spikes at step 2 of staged siphon. Hypothesis: batch window too small for high fanout namespaces.

2026-03-12 - Investigation: observed tail-latency amplification when parallel replay threads exceeded 128 on g4dn-like nodes. Temporary mitigation: backpressure gating and dynamic worker scaling in replay harness.

2026-03-14 - Current: mitigation merged to PR #2764, SRE adjusted circuit-breaker integration to include 'replay-latency' metric. Next: full scheduled rehearsal with canary traffic on 2026-03-22. Follow-ups assigned.
